# 2. BlockForest survival prediction

```{r}
library(blockForest)
```

## Load and select data

```{r}
metadata_selected <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/BlockForest/key_features_processed.rds")
```

```{r}
# Select colnames based on prefix
selected <- colnames(metadata_selected)#[str_detect(colnames(metadata_selected),"IMC")]

# Filter for complete cases (all data available)
meta <- metadata_selected %>% select(PID, status_OS, OS_months, all_of(selected)) %>% filter(complete.cases(.))

str(meta)
```

## Split survival and test

```{r}
# Select Y and X for blockforest
y <- meta %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% select(OS_months, status_OS)

x <- meta %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% select(-OS_months, -status_OS)

# Add surv time as test 
#x$CLIN_OS_months <- y$OS_months
```

## Folds

```{r}
# Create train/test splits considering similar censoring rates
set.seed(22)
library(caret)
folds <- createDataPartition(y$status_OS, p = 0.75, times = 5)
```

## Define blocks 

```{r}
# Create blocks 
# Initialize empty list for blocks
block <- list()

# Define blocks based on column names containing "CLIN" and "IMC"
block[[1]] <- which(grepl("CLIN", colnames(x)))
block[[2]] <- which(grepl("IMC", colnames(x)))

# Display the block list
print(block)
```

## Perform BlockForest

### 5fold CV (Outer)

#### Define function 

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(blockForest)
library(survival)

# Create a function for 5 fold outer cross-validation
cross_validate_blockforest <- function(x, y, folds, block) {
  results <- vector("list", length(folds))
  
  for (i in seq_along(folds)) {
    
    print(paste("CV iteration:", i))
    
    # Split the data into training and test sets
    x_train <- x[folds[[i]],]
    x_test <- x[-folds[[i]],]

    y_train <- y[folds[[i]],]
    y_test <- y[-folds[[i]],]
    
    # Train the blockForest model
    blockforobj <- blockfor(X = x_train, 
                            y = as.matrix(y_train), 
                            blocks = block,
                            splitrule = "extratrees", 
                            block.method = "BlockForest",
                            num.trees = 2000,
                            nsets = 300, 
                            num.trees.pre = 1500,
                            always.select.block = 1,
                            num.threads = 30,
                            importance = "permutation")
    
    # Make predictions on the test data
    predres <- predict(blockforobj$forest, data = x_test)
    
    # Store the results for evaluation, e.g., store predicted survival functions
    results[[i]] <- list(predictions = predres,
                         actual_test = x_test,
                         actual_surv = y_test, 
                         variable_importance = blockforobj$forest$variable.importance)
    
    gc()
  }
  
  return(results)
}
```

## Run and save results

# CONTINUE HERE - Re-running models after selection 

```{r}
# Run cross-validation
set.seed(22)
cv_results <- cross_validate_blockforest(x, y, folds, block)

# Adjust naming!
saveRDS(cv_results, "/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/tumor_panel/data_analysis/BlockForest/BF_IMConly_tumor_panel_zscored.rds")
```

#### Simple

```{r}
set.seed(22)

x_train <- x[folds[[1]],]
x_test <- x[-folds[[1]],]

y_train <- y[folds[[1]],]
y_test <- y[-folds[[1]],]

all.equal(rownames(x_train), rownames(y_train))
all.equal(rownames(x_test), rownames(y_test))

# Train the blockForest model
blockforobj <- blockfor(x_train, as.matrix(y_train), 
                        blocks = block,
                        splitrule = "extratrees", 
                        block.method = "BlockForest",
                        num.trees = 2000,
                        nsets = 300, 
                        num.trees.pre = 1500,
                        always.select.block = 1, 
                        num.threads = 30,
                        importance = "permutation")
    
# Make predictions on the test data
predres <- predict(blockforobj$forest, data = x_test, block.method = "BlockForest")
```

```{r}
concordance(Surv(y_test$OS_months, y_test$status_OS) ~ rowSums(predres$survival), timewt="n/G2")
```

```{r}
scale(blockforobj$forest$variable.importance)
```
